categories.main_business_segments: Shennan Circuits Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: printed circuit boards (PCBs), electronic assembly, and packaging substrates. The company has developed a unique '3-In-One' business model integrating these segments, covering the entire value chain from sample to mass production, including design, manufacturing, assembly, micro-assembly, and testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-end PCB design and manufacturing, including multilayer boards, high-frequency microwave boards, metal substrates, and HDI boards. It also develops advanced packaging substrates such as BT-type substrates with wire bonding (WB) and flip-chip (FC) technologies, including FC-BGA and FC-CSP. Manufacturing methods include modified semi-additive process (MSAP), embedded trace substrate (ETS), through-hole technology (THT), surface mount technology (SMT), and microelectronic packaging technology (MPT).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global leading enterprises in telecommunications, data centers, automotive electronics, semiconductor packaging, industrial control, medical electronics, and consumer electronics. The company serves markets requiring high-frequency, high-density, high-speed, high-reliability, and high-thermal-performance electronic interconnect solutions, with a focus on wireless base stations, AI acceleration cards, millimeter-wave radar, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Wuxi, Nantong, Guangzhou, and overseas subsidiaries in the USA, Germany, Hong Kong, and Thailand. Domestic sales account for approximately 63% of revenue, while overseas sales represent about 33%, with active market development in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shennan Circuits operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronics supply chain. It manufactures PCBs and packaging substrates (midstream) and provides electronic assembly and system integration services (downstream), covering stages from component interconnection to module and system assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological leadership with a focus on 5G communications, AI, data centers, automotive electronics, and high-end semiconductor packaging substrates. R&D priorities include high-speed, high-density interconnects, high-frequency microwave technology, thermal management, and advanced packaging technologies such as FC-BGA and FC-CSP. R&D investment increased to 7.93% of revenue in 2023, with ongoing projects targeting next-generation communication circuits, AI acceleration, and automotive electronics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including PCBs, packaging substrates, and electronic assembly services. The company operates on a direct sales model, providing customized manufacturing and integrated solutions to customers, with additional income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shennan Circuits is a leading player in China's electronic circuit industry and a pioneer in packaging substrates. It ranks eighth globally among PCB manufacturers according to Prismark 2023 Q4 report. The company holds a strong position in wireless base station RF PCB supply, domestic packaging substrate market, and processor chip packaging substrates, competing with global and domestic PCB and semiconductor packaging firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 13.53 billion, a 3.33% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.398 billion, down 14.81%. Despite short-term market challenges, the company maintains a solid financial scale with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company’s asset base exceeds RMB 14.5 billion with a stable capital structure and an asset-liability ratio of 41.67%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shennan Circuits offers a comprehensive '3-In-One' integrated solution combining PCB manufacturing, packaging substrates, and electronic assembly, enabling one-stop, efficient, and high-quality service. The company emphasizes advanced technology, high reliability, and customization capabilities, supported by strong R&D and manufacturing expertise. Its products cater to high-frequency, high-density, and high-performance applications, differentiating through technological innovation, quality stability, and close customer collaboration.
